messages:
Carmen (growth): Quick check-in — noticed the weekly KPI dashboard shows a weird bump in campaign sessions from launch posts, but conversion rhythm looks off. Could be attribution or a reporting rollup. Can we triage before the Monday KPI readout? :mag:
Theo: I spotted something odd in the dashboard tiles: the campaign time window is rolling to UTC midnight while our GA view is Pacific. That can create apparent spikes when posts go out near midnight PT.
Anika: Good call. Also we ran a creative A/B (copy A vs copy B) and reused the same utm_campaign name for both variants. That will make campaign-level performance noisy.
Carmen (growth): Ah — so two separate issues: timezone aggregation + campaign naming reuse. That explains the benchmark narrative looking better for sessions but not for downstream MQLs.
MetricBot: Quick summary pull: week-over-week campaign=launch_v2 sessions +34%, leads +4%, mqls +2. Time-bucket check: 40% of the session lift is from 23:30-00:30 PT window (06:30-07:30 UTC).
Theo: That aligns with a scheduled midnight post we ran for EMEA. If the dashboard bucketing switches to UTC then those sessions get counted in the following day's week which inflates the 'this week' number.
Anika: On the naming side I can reconcile the creative variants by looking at landing_template + creative_id in the event payloads. We should avoid reusing utm_campaign next time. Tiny ops ask: can marketing naming guidelines get a short doc? :memo:
Jules: Also, the webinar nurture flow has a delayed MQL rule (needs two touch events in 14 days). Webinar regs convert quickly to engaged leads but might not hit MQL until nurture. That will mute short-term MQL lift.
Carmen (growth): Action items:
- Theo: confirm dashboard time-bucket config and add a short annotation explaining the PT/UTC mismatch.
- Anika: provide reconciled CSV mapping creative_id -> utm_campaign and landing_template by EOD Monday.
- Jules: pull registration->MQL timing distribution for webinar vs launch posts.
- I'll prepare a one-paragraph benchmark narrative for the KPI review explaining how timing and naming affected apparent performance.
Theo: Will add annotation now and check tile configs. If it's a quick dashboard change I can flip to PT rolling day to match GA view.
Anika: I'll run the SQL to join events -> creative_id and push the CSV link here. SQL snippet I used:
```
SELECT e.date_local, e.landing_template, e.creative_id, e.utm_campaign, count(DISTINCT e.user_id) AS sessions
FROM page_events e
WHERE e.campaign_name = 'launch_v2'
  AND e.date_local BETWEEN '2026-03-16' AND '2026-03-22'
GROUP BY 1,2,3,4
ORDER BY sessions DESC;
```
Jules: I'll compute median time-to-mql and pctiles for webinar_registrants vs social_launch_registrants and share a small chart. Expect results by Monday 08:30 PT.
MetricBot: Annotation added to kpi-weekly: "2026-03-19 dashboard time-bucket (UTC) vs GA (PT) mismatch may inflate week-over-week session counts for posts sent near PT midnight. Creative A/B reused utm_campaign; see reconciled CSV (coming)."
Carmen (growth): Nice. Also let's add a tiny blurb in the KPI narrative: "Apparent session lift partially driven by timezone aggregation and naming reuse; downstream MQLs are tracking with expected funnel timing for lightweight forms and webinar nurture." I'll paste draft when ready.
Anika: CSV link posted: https://files.redwood.com/marketing/launch_v2_creative_map.csv
Theo: Dashboard tile now set to PT rolling day. That reduced the apparent week-over-week bump; I'll leave the annotation for visibility.
Jules: Uploaded chart and short table. Webinar regs → MQL median 11 days; social launch regs → MQL median 4 days. That explains shorter-term differences.
Carmen (growth): Perfect — this is exactly what we'll explain in Monday's KPI review. Thanks team. Closing this thread unless anything else pops up. :tada:
